[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: Direction, UAT and acceptance of gotde POD engine evaluation and bilingual vendor report
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1868
  
  Details:
  Governor direction, UAT and acceptance testing of the gotde.cn print-on-demand engine evaluation for the Agroverse 50g ceremonial cacao bar.
  
  DIRECTION AND REVIEW PROVIDED
  - Set the objective across the engagement: pull the full template library for review, select candidate templates, and drive iterative rendering.
  - Directed the branding requirement: the engine must use the actual Agroverse logo rather than a synthesised wordmark, and made the judgement call selecting Approach A (real mark keyed to gold on panel) as the approved method.
  - Directed that the chosen approach be recorded durably in the print-on-demand agentic AI context so it survives across sessions (resulting in the runbook in the evidence PR).
  - Posed the two questions that produced the decisive findings: whether the engine could accept our logo during generation, and whether a fixed logo location could be requested. Both were tested rather than assumed, and both resolved to negative findings that reshaped the approach.
  - Commissioned the bilingual EN/ZH technical report for the vendor's engineering team.
  - Reviewed and accepted the rendered outputs across the template batches and rejected/refined direction where the placement was wrong.
  
  UAT / ACCEPTANCE
  - Repeatedly challenged reported results, which surfaced a defective panel-detection algorithm and a stale "HTTP-only / expired certificate" claim. Both were retracted and corrected as a direct result. The resulting runbook and vendor report reflect the corrected findings.
  
  EVIDENCE
  https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1868 - print-on-demand runbook authored and merged (db2b8b1)
  
  SCOPE NOTE
  Governor (human) direction and UAT time for this engagement. Filed as a separate row from Sophia Truesight's engineering time to preserve distinct agent vs. human attribution per AI_AGENT_DAO_REGISTRATION.md. Filed under governor instruction "just file it"; the signed submission carries the governor's authorization.
